items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) officially active vs CAR after expected-to-play reports. Limited practice week but cleared.
items.why: Calf strain; expected per sources, not on inactives
items.implication: Start with confidence; typical WR role alongside others
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snap/route share expected

items.text: Malik Nabers (knee/ACL recovery) status murky for SNF vs DAL; up to him after full practices. Giants elevated Berrios and Cambre. Main slate otherwise locked; projections update live.
items.why: Full practices but non-committal; long-term health priority post-ACL/meniscus
items.implication: Monitor 90-min inactives; if out, thin NYG WR room; if in, WR2 upside with limits possible
items.opportunity: If OUT: targets to Fields/Mooney/Beckham/Berrios; if IN: high volume

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL) not expected to play and later confirmed inactive vs DET. Full participant late week but not ready; elevates Etienne and secondary backs.
items.why: MCL sprain; full practice Friday but sources say not quite ready
items.implication: Clear path for NO RBs; drop/bench Kamara short-term
items.opportunity: Bulk carries + passing downs to Etienne

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown no surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.why: High ankle sprain; no surgery needed
items.implication: IR candidate; look to NE WR depth short-term
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for other NE receivers

items.text: Roughly all main-slate news locked; only major projection variable is Nabers for SNF. Projections live and updating; no other major changes expected.
items.why: Inactive window largely complete for early games
items.implication: Lock lineups on confirmed statuses; monitor Nabers only

items.text: Brock Bowers OUT Week 1 after meniscus trim Tuesday; Raiders believe realistic chance he misses only one game and returns Week 2 at LAC. Mayer fills role.
items.why: Meniscus trim; team optimistic on quick turnaround
items.implication: Hold; short absence boosts stash value. Start Mayer this week
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE1 volume vs MIA

items.text: Cooper Rush will start at QB for Falcons; Tua and Penix inactive. Olamide Zaccheaus emergency QB and also emergency third RB (only Bijan and Brian Robinson active at RB).
items.implication: Bijan full workload locked; monitor pass game efficiency with Rush
items.opportunity: Bijan bellcow; Zaccheaus multi-role but low fantasy

items.text: Kamara's status directly impacts Travis Etienne projection upward with clear lead back role vs DET.
items.implication: Etienne top-10 RB upside this week

items.text: Weekend status summary: Love and Odunze expected; Kamara not; Josh Williams activated (Sean Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet.
items.implication: Core Sunday AM guide for lineup locks
items.opportunity: Williams elevation if Tucker out; Etienne boost

items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) expected to play vs LAC in NFL debut. Questionable after limited practices but trending positive.
items.why: High-ankle sprain from preseason; limited all week but sources confirm debut
items.implication: Viable RB2/flex; may share with Allgeier, possible ease-in
items.opportunity: Explosive carries + pass-catching; goal-line to Allgeier possible

items.text: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. officially inactive (back) vs ATL; future murky with possible in-season trade amid contract dispute.
items.implication: PIT secondary adjustment; low fantasy relevance

items.text: Rams DE Myles Garrett to IR after arthroscopic knee surgery; misses minimum 4 games (Giants, Broncos, Eagles, Bills). Hope for 4-week return.
items.why: Knee issues limiting since camp; surgery
items.implication: LAR defensive drop-off; limited fantasy IDP impact

items.text: Josh Jacobs remains on Commissioner Exempt list; NFL could count time as served toward potential suspension (CBA 6-game min for DV, variable).
items.implication: GB RB volume to others short-term; hold for clarity

items.text: Berry Happy Hour covering Nabers decision, Jeremiyah Love, Cooper Rush impact, CAR RBs, MIN RB, Mahomes start/sit, Marshawn Lloyd expectations, JAX WRs.
items.why: Live noon ET last-call show on key decisions
items.implication: Per-player Love/Hate and start/sit signals forthcoming in show

items.text: Josh Williams activated with Sean Tucker doubtful; impacts TB backfield split potentially favoring Irving/Gainwell more cleanly.
items.why: Activation of Williams signals Tucker unlikely

items.text: Matthew Berry keeping it open on Chuba Hubbard as a viable flex play this week.
items.why: Viable flex in CAR backfield situation
items.implication: Flex consideration if thin at RB
